notes: Crownreach now covers approximately 30 square miles with 264 by 900 foot buildable blocks, varied neighborhoods and a 100,000-monkey census. Every visible resident uses the player monkey anatomy at heights from 5 ft 7 in to 6 ft 2 in. Life-size vehicle classes have visible seated drivers, an A-Z search catalog and purchasable dealership inventory. Lantern Central Park includes woodland, walking and cycling paths, yoga, dog walkers, social areas and a large lake with four usable rowboats. Penthouses overlook the actual city and use collision-checked full-body furniture motion. Shops transfer finite goods; ownership and credits persist. Vehicle impacts damage machines, with bounded fire and debris; severe aircraft-building impacts dispatch emergency and reconstruction crews and restore the building the following game morning. Source network protocol 18 requires matching clients and server; bootstrap 3 is retained.
